name: brain-fm
title: Brain.fm
description: Control the Brain.fm web player and see the current track, timer, and browser media session.
author: itsdanielsultan

preferences.name: browser
preferences.title: Brain.fm Browser
preferences.description: Browser containing your signed-in Brain.fm player tab. Other tabs and media apps are never controlled.

commands.name: now-playing
commands.title: Now Playing
commands.subtitle: Brain.fm
commands.description: Read the current Brain.fm track, playback state, timer, and media-session information.

commands.name: play
commands.title: Play
commands.subtitle: Brain.fm
commands.description: Resume your current Brain.fm session without toggling an already-playing session.

commands.name: pause
commands.title: Pause
commands.subtitle: Brain.fm
commands.description: Pause your current Brain.fm session without toggling an already-paused session.

commands.name: toggle-play-pause
commands.title: Play/Pause
commands.subtitle: Brain.fm
commands.description: Toggle playback in your Brain.fm player tab.

commands.name: skip
commands.title: Skip Track
commands.subtitle: Brain.fm
commands.description: Use Brain.fm's Skip track control and verify the track changed.

commands.name: previous
commands.title: Previous Track
commands.subtitle: Brain.fm
commands.description: Use Brain.fm's Previous track control and verify the track changed.

commands.name: menu-bar
commands.title: Brain.fm Menu Bar
commands.description: See the current Brain.fm track and timer in the menu bar and control playback.

preferences.name: showTitle
preferences.title: Menu Bar Title
preferences.label: Show the track name while playing
preferences.description: Display the current track next to the icon while Brain.fm is playing.
